decisions.reason: It is a differentiated, low-noise improvement to the core infrared-heating line and likely supports retrofit and premium applications, so we would retain it.
This plaque heater was prominently presented and fits the firm's core offer for efficient large-space heating, indicating a committed product line.
It still belongs to the established radiant-heating portfolio, but its niche positioning and somewhat higher regulatory exposure make it less secure than the main lines.
Tube heaters are a standard solution for industrial halls and commercial buildings, so keeping at least one strong tube-heater line is strategically sensible.
The standard plaque heater helps cover a broader price-performance segment in the core market, even if it overlaps somewhat with the other plaque heater.
With another tube-heater product already covering the same core application and little sign of distinct positioning, we would simplify the range and withdraw this variant.
